_map: The same 观内 as 外门 (Hanli, 2026-10-15): the years are spent on the mountain; 内门 too goes below only on a 执事堂 令 — 周衡: 「份例不跟着涨。差的，自己挣——执事堂揭牌，下山打妖。」 (07-第七回). Ways past the map and the way home as world.mjs leaveOf / fitLeave.

say.zh: 份例不跟着涨。差的，自己挣——执事堂揭牌，才下得了山。
say.en: The allowance does not grow. What you lack, you earn — take a tag at the stewards' hall, and only then go down the mountain.

back.zh: 没有令，下不得山。你回到了外门。
back.en: Without a pass there is no going down. You are back in the outer court.

summary.zh: 大比第二天搬屋，你把赤铜葫芦和盾片扔进饭桶图个干净，它吐出一口剑「火柴」；开春，残株分堆认出方子，饭桶的九转丹叫你进步神速。饭堂里说你偷药园，周衡说「拿赃来」；丹房的闵丹师叫你去看了一颗：「没有火气。」一晃五年，执事堂的差事牌一块一块揭，一年一层；第五年腊八你赢了大比，观里那颗一转的官丹封好收进储物袋；入秋，九层圆满，又揭了那块蒙山的牌子——黑松岭。瞿老讲了他最后一个徒弟——九月初三，你在崖顶筑基。
summary.en: Moving house the day after the contest, you toss the red-copper gourd and the shield shards into the Rice Bucket to be rid of them, and it spits out a sword, Matchstick; in spring you sort the culls by herb and find the recipes, and the Rice Bucket's nine-turn pills carry you up by leaps. The dining hall says you rob the herb garden; Zhou Heng says "bring the stolen goods"; Pill-master Min of the pill house sends for you and looks at one pill: "No fire in it." Five years go by on the Stewards' Hall's tags, a layer a year; at Laba in the fifth year you win the contest, and the temple's one-turn pill, resealed, goes into the storage pouch; in autumn, ninth layer perfected — and you take down the Mengshan tag: Black Pine Ridge. Elder Qu told of his last disciple — and on the third of the ninth month you lay your Foundation on the cliff.

intro.zh: 大比第二天搬屋，他把储物袋倒了个底朝天，一样一样理，理出两样废物。
intro.en: The day after the contest he moved, and turned the storage pouch out onto the boards to sort it, one thing at a time; two pieces of rubbish came out.

mystery.zh: 瞿老四十多年没收过徒弟——他上一个徒弟，后来怎样了？
mystery.en: Elder Qu took no disciple for more than forty years — what became of the last one?

A 回 that ends inside the chapter has its own (close.hui.<id>, 2026-10-15: 「第八回 · 完」 once opened on 古七's 饭桶): 古七's did and teaser at 09-dabi, from the book's own lines (07-第七回's 除夕); the chapter's did and teaser are 古八's.

did.zh: 腊八赢下了大比，观里那颗一转的官丹，粘好封条收进了储物袋
did.en: won the contest at Laba, and glued the abbey's one-turn pill's seal back and put it in the storage pouch

did.zh: 九月初三，你在崖顶筑了基——师父问几道纹，你说一道
did.en: and on the third of the ninth month you laid your Foundation on the cliff — your master asked how many lines, and you said one

teaser.zh: 却说北边漳水之滨，有一座邺城，城里年年要给河伯娶一回媳妇。今年巫祝挑中的新娘子，是城西卖豆腐的哑女——那时你还不知道，这门亲事，是要你去搅上一搅的。
teaser.en: Up north on the Zhang stands the city of Ye, which marries a bride to the River Lord every year. This year the shaman chose the mute girl who sells tofu on the west side — and you did not yet know that this wedding was yours to spoil.

did.zh: 大比第二天搬屋，你把赤铜葫芦和盾片扔进饭桶图个干净，它吐出一口剑「火柴」
did.en: Moving house the day after the contest, tossed the red-copper gourd and the shield shards into the Rice Bucket to be rid of them, and it spat out a sword, Matchstick

did.zh: 腊月十五，瞿老在崖顶画了九格，教你走禹步：「这一步，叫入。」
did.en: on the fifteenth of the twelfth month Elder Qu drew nine squares on the clifftop and taught you the Step of Yu: "This step is called entering"

did.zh: 闵丹师闻了三回你那颗丹：「没有火气。」叫你守他的炉
did.en: Pill-master Min smelled your pill three times — "There's no fire in it" — and set you to watch his burner

did.zh: 五年里揭了执事堂的差事牌，一层一式，练到了七层
did.en: and through five years you took down the Stewards' Hall's errand tags, a form a layer, up to the seventh

teaser.zh: 那年除夕，周衡照旧去正殿求观主，放他去邺城，把漳水上「河伯娶妇」那桩事给断了。观主照旧是那一句：「要去，也得是个筑了基的。」只是这一回，说完了，他往后殿静室那边看了一眼。
teaser.en: That New Year's Eve Zhou Heng went to the main hall to plead with the Abbot as usual: to let him go to Ye and put an end to the "River Lord takes a bride" business on the Zhang. The Abbot said the same thing as always: "Whoever goes has to have Foundation Establishment." Only this time, when he'd said it, he glanced towards the quiet room in the back hall.
